issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{は/が|wa-topic}毎朝[まいあさ]パン{を|o-object}焼[や]きます。
issues.problem: 毎朝パンを焼く in a home routine means toasting bread; 'bakes bread every morning' mistranslates it.
issues.action: English changed to 'My mother toasts bread every morning.'

issues.jp_before: おじいさん{は/が|wa-topic}毎朝[まいあさ]お茶[ちゃ]{を|o-object}飲[の]みます。
issues.problem: Bare おじいさん is not 'my grandfather' (it could be any old man); the English overstated it.
issues.action: English changed to 'Grandpa drinks tea every morning.'

issues.jp_before: 父[ちち]{は/が|wa-topic}日曜日[にちようび]{に|ni-time}庭[にわ]{の|no-possessive}木[き]{を|o-object}切[き]ります。
issues.problem: 木を切る means cutting trees down, which is implausible as a weekly routine.
issues.action: Rewritten as 庭の草を取ります 'pulls the weeds in the garden'; why updated.

issues.jp_before: 昼[ひる]、母[はは]{と|to-and}父[ちち]{は/が|wa-topic}うどん{を|o-object}食[た]べました。
issues.problem: The fixed order is 父と母; 母と父 sounds unnatural.
issues.action: Swapped to 父と母, English adjusted to match.

issues.jp_before: 明日[あした]、傘[かさ]{が|ga-stative}要[い]ります{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: This was a near-duplicate of the お弁当が要りますか item, and the English 'Will I need' was an odd reading.
issues.action: Rewritten as 明日は傘が要りません 'You won't need an umbrella tomorrow.'; f moved to 1.

issues.jp_before: 夕[ゆう]ご飯[はん]{が|ga-stative}できました。
issues.problem: Here できる means 'be ready / come into being', not ability or the object of a stative predicate, so ga-stative is the wrong skill id.

issues.jp_before: 今[いま]、お水[みず]{が|ga-stative}欲[ほ]しいです{か|ka-question}。
issues.problem: Asking someone directly 欲しいですか is socially unnatural, and 今 sounds odd here.
issues.action: Replaced with 母は新しい冷蔵庫が欲しいそうです 'My mother says she wants a new fridge.'

issues.jp_before: 姉[あね]{は/が|wa-topic}スキー{が|ga-stative}できます。
issues.problem: The distractor を is not plainly wrong: スキーをできます is common in natural speech.
issues.action: Replaced with 姉の部屋から海が見えます (ga-sense), where を is impossible; this also adds variety.

issues.jp_before: 妹[いもうと]{は/が|wa-topic}泳[およ]ぎ{が|ga-stative}下手[へた]です。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of the 弟は歌が下手です frame; the file already had 2 other 下手 items and many in the same X は Y が skill-adjective frame.
issues.action: Replaced with 隣の部屋から音楽が聞こえます (ga-sense) for variety; を is impossible.
